name: catalog/task_timeout
description: A worker task request other than a chunk (ingest, finalize, publish, enlarge, sweep) ran past its deadline and Cloud Run answered 504. Every batch-wide step is meant to stop on a time budget and hand on, so any 504 here means a step grew with the batch and was not split.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND resource.labels.service_name="catalog-worker" AND logName="projects/image-links-agent/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status=504 AND httpRequest.requestUrl:"/tasks/catalog/" AND NOT httpRequest.requestUrl:"/tasks/catalog/chunk"
